native_path: Two files in the Pi agent directory (location not stated in the fetched pages): models.json and settings.json.
invocation: pi in RPC or print mode inside a container with the worktree mounted; wait for the agent_settled event before reading output
limitations: Provider keys follow the Ollama example in the docs. The DeepSeek base URL and the way Pi reads an API key from the environment were not confirmed.
Pi has no built-in subagents or permission prompts. Run it in a container or VM with no credentials beyond the model key.
MCP arrives through Codemode and packages add subagents, memory and sandboxing; none are enabled here.
Requires Node 22.19 or newer. No install, load or dry-run was executed.
role_binding: Pi is a worker or reviewer seat with a clear settle signal. One model per session; the caller walks the fallback chain.

profiles.ultimate: Worker for A05, A06 and A09 alternates; reviewer for A04, A08 and A10.
profiles.hybrid: Same roles. Model rows follow the matrix.
profiles.b4b: Same roles with the cheaper rungs first.
profiles.global: Same roles with the global pools.
